headline: UBA seeks jail terms for WEMPCO directors in N61 billion loan dispute
summary: United Bank for Africa asked a Lagos court to imprison nine individuals linked to Western Metal Products Co. over a disputed N61.45 billion loan.
why: Aggressive loan recovery actions by tier-1 banks highlight asset quality management and credit risk resolution in emerging market lending portfolios.

impacts.name: United Bank for Africa
impacts.why: Legal efforts to recover multi-billion naira non-performing loans affect bank asset quality and legal provisions.
